home.title: Welcome to DocFlow
home.body: Upload an invoice or a contract. It is read, its fields are extracted and checked, and anything the checks are unsure about is held for you to review.

home.title: 1. Pick the document type
home.body: Invoice or Contract. Each has its own set of fields to extract.

home.title: 2. Drop your file
home.body: PDF, PNG or JPG, up to 10 MB. Scanned pages and photos are read with OCR.

home.title: Free demo allowance
home.body: How many free extractions this browser session has left.

home.title: 3. Follow it in Documents
home.body: Every upload is listed there with its status. Open the menu or the Documents link next.

documents.title: Your documents
documents.body: Only this browser session's uploads are shown. The status refreshes every 3 seconds: processing, then completed, or awaiting review when the checks were not sure.

documents.title: Open a document
documents.body: Review shows what was extracted and, when a document is held, why.

review.title: Why it was held
review.body: When the checks are not sure, the reason is written here, for example that subtotal plus tax does not equal the total.

review.title: Confidence and fields
review.body: The confidence summarises how sure the checks are. A field below 75% is flagged in red. The values are read-only: compare them with your document.

review.title: Approve or reject
review.body: Approve completes the document. Reject asks for a reason, which is saved and shown in the list.

review.title: Export
review.body: Once a document is completed, download its extracted data as JSON or CSV.
